questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the scope of incentives in educational management:
I. Incentives are solely applicable to teaching staff and not to administrative staff in schools.
II. A balanced incentive system utilizes a mix of both monetary and non-monetary rewards.
III. The perceived fairness of the incentive distribution process significantly impacts its effectiveness.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b) because educational management systems operate effectively when incentives apply to both teaching and administrative personnel, as operational success depends on total organizational cohesion. A balanced framework combines monetary rewards for basic economic needs with non-monetary recognition for higher psychological fulfillment. Furthermore, perceived fairness and procedural justice during reward distribution directly influence staff trust, morale, and long-term organizational commitment.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। शैक्षिक प्रबंधन प्रणाली तब प्रभावी रूप से कार्य करती हैं जब प्रोत्साहन शिक्षण और प्रशासनिक दोनों कर्मचारियों पर लागू होते हैं, क्योंकि संचालन की सफलता कुल संगठनात्मक एकता पर निर्भर करती है। एक संतुलित ढांचा मौद्रिक पुरस्कारों को बुनियादी आर्थिक आवश्यकताओं के लिए और गैर-मौद्रिक मान्यता को उच्च मनोवैज्ञानिक संतोष के लिए जोड़ता है। इसके अलावा, पुरस्कार वितरण के दौरान perceived fairness और प्रक्रियात्मक न्याय सीधे कर्मचारियों के विश्वास, मनोबल और दीर्घकालिक संगठनात्मक प्रतिबद्धता को प्रभावित करते हैं।

A highly dedicated Primary teacher in a government school uses puppetry, local crafts, and neighborhood field trips to teach EVS, resulting in zero dropouts and high attendance. questions.question_english: A major limitation of relying solely on monetary incentives in education is the 'Crowding-Out Effect.' What does this mean?
options_english: Too many teachers crowd the Principal’s office demanding immediate extra monetary compensation
High employee salaries severely crowd out the statutory budget reserved for school infrastructure
Monetary incentives directly lead to severely overcrowded classrooms and poor teacher-student ratios
External monetary rewards diminish a teacher’s intrinsic motivation
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'External monetary rewards diminish a teacher’s intrinsic motivation'. The crowding-out effect describes how introducing external financial rewards can diminish an individual’s intrinsic motivation for inherently rewarding tasks. When educators perform meaningful teaching duties primarily for cash payouts, their internal passion, altruism, and personal commitment can decline. This psychological shift converts professional duty into a transactional exchange, reducing long-term engagement.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। क्राउडिंग-आउट प्रभाव यह दर्शाता है कि बाहरी वित्तीय पुरस्कारों का परिचय देना किसी व्यक्ति की अंतर्निहित प्रेरणा को कम कर सकता है। जब शिक्षक मुख्य रूप से नकद भुगतान के लिए अर्थपूर्ण शिक्षण कार्य करते हैं, तो उनकी आंतरिक प्रेरणा, परोपकारिता और व्यक्तिगत प्रतिबद्धता कम हो सकती है। यह मनोवैज्ञानिक बदलाव पेशेवर कर्तव्य को एक लेन-देन के आदान-प्रदान में बदल देता है, जिससे दीर्घकालिक संलग्नता कम होती है।

questions.question_english: A potential drawback of Group Incentive Schemes is the 'Free-rider problem.' In a school context, this refers to:
options_english: Teachers using the official school transport bus service without paying monthly fees

The school management refusing to allocate funds for the proposed incentive scheme

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d) because the free-rider problem occurs when underperforming or disengaged members of a group benefit from the collective rewards without contributing adequately to the group's efforts. questions.question_english: If monetary incentives are the only motivational tool employed, it may lead to a transactional culture. A transactional culture in a school is characterized by:
options_english: Deep emotional bonding, empathy, and mutual care between teaching staff and enrolled students
Teachers doing only what is explicitly paid for and nothing extra

questions.explanation_english: Relying exclusively on monetary incentives fosters a transactional workplace culture where employees perform strictly what is explicitly rewarded, refusing extra uncompensated duties. questions.explanation_english: Providing dedicated access to research rooms and advanced pedagogical tools functions as an incentive based on enabling conditions and professional privileges. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। सक्षम परिस्थितियों और पेशेवर विशेषाधिकार प्रदान करना शिक्षकों को उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली शिक्षा देने के लिए आवश्यक संसाधनों से लैस करता है, जो उन्हें बेहतर प्रदर्शन करने में मदद करता है। यह प्रोत्साहन वैधानिक सेवा अधिकारों या वित्तीय मुआवजे से भिन्न है।
